persistence.scope: Validation depth-SSIM calibration only. These are volume-only diagnostics, not trained generators or fair comparisons to historical models with different information budgets.
limitations: Starting-volume persistence receives 20 known initial volumes; historical price-anchor-only or price-context-only generators did not receive this information.
Identity and shuffled-real controls consume validation outcomes and cannot be used as forecasting baselines or deployed simulators.
Only volume slots enter DepthSSIM. Price slots are zero placeholders, and no price, validity, spread, return or trading-reliability score is computed.
High depth SSIM can reflect persistent level-wise volume shape; these controls do not establish realistic dynamics, conditional diversity or uncertainty.
All summaries use one day and the fixed validation protocol. Per-window variation is descriptive, not generation-seed or retraining uncertainty.
The standard preprocessor audits the full raw day and creates all splits. This script subsequently reads only train and validation; no final-test diagnostics are computed.

preprocessing_audit.split_method: 70/15/15 of elapsed session time by default; split before returns and windows
preprocessing_audit.sampling: event time; irregular wall-clock intervals are retained as metadata
preprocessing_audit.initial_state: Each sequence requires its own 20-price anchor for reconstruction.

scaler.method: per-feature min-max, training period only, no clipping

depth_specification.images: Separate ask and bid images, each 10 levels x sequence_length updates; levels 1 through 10.
depth_specification.aggregation: Mean over valid 7x7 windows, then equal mean of sides, sequences and generation seeds.
depth_specification.clipping: none; negative or above-training-range depths stay in the score and validity checks
depth_specification.reference_range: Nominal training reference range [0, 1]; fixed even for held-out or generated extremes.
depth_specification.variant: Wang et al. SSIM equation; 7x7 uniform windows/sample covariance, not the paper's 11x11 Gaussian setting.

validation_protocol.case_rule: First, middle and last eligible validation windows, fixed before scoring.

training_mean.definition: Arithmetic mean raw shares per side/level over the complete training segment.

shuffle.method: Seeded full-cycle derangement of whole validation windows; every donor used once.

anchor_volume_persistence.description: Hold each window's known 20 starting volumes fixed through all 32 future updates; no future-volume information.

training_mean_volume.description: Hold the arithmetic mean shares at each side/level from all raw training snapshots fixed through all updates and windows; no validation fitting.

shuffled_real_volume.description: Oracle negative control: pair each validation target with another complete real validation volume window under one fixed derangement. Uses held-out future volumes and is not a simulator.

identity.description: Oracle identity check: each real validation volume window is compared with itself; this is not a forecast or generator.

real_volume_changes.scope: Exact share-count changes. Within-window measures use future updates 1..32 (31 transitions); anchor-inclusive measures add update 0..1 (32 transitions). Fractions average the 20 ask/bid volume cells equally.
real_volume_changes.profile_scope: Descriptive exact equality and absolute changes in the official training-scaled log-volume transform; no estimated independent-sample uncertainty or autocorrelation significance.
